queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery identified Rajasthan's BhuNaksha and Apna Khata services and official Rajasthan land-record/cadastral documentation. The results evidence state and district land-record custody, but not a public Sikar city parcel geometry response.

registryBasis: Official Rajasthan BhuNaksha and Apna Khata services establish a Rajasthan cadastral/land-record custodian. An official Rajasthan personnel/cadre record separately identifies the Collector (Land Record), Sikar, and Tehsildar, Sikar. This supports local custodial responsibility, but does not establish a citywide open parcel API.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan BhuNaksha cadastral mapping viewer; public page was identified, but direct retrieval from this environment timed out. No viewer schema, CRS, or parcel payload was retained.
Official Rajasthan Apna Khata land-record portal; page exposes district selection for Jamabandi copies, but direct request from this environment timed out and no parcel geometry was captured.

Official Rajasthan Urban GIS portal exposes District/Tehsil/Village/Khasra search and map functions and states that Khasra/village boundaries come from the Settlement Department. Its disclaimer limits displayed data to viewing use.

Official Rajasthan cadre record lists COLLECTOR (LAND RECORD) and TEHSILDAR for SIKAR under the Revenue Department, supporting a local land-record custodian. This is administrative evidence, not a parcel API.
Official Board of Revenue page documents digitization of cadastral maps in Rajasthan; it is general state agency documentation and not city-specific geometry.
